title: Curiosity Mars rover sizes up new 'Nazca' dig site | Space photo of the day for Nov. 10, 2026
caption:
The Curiosity rover is investigating bizarre, disk-shaped mineral formations on Mars. These structures could be key to understanding the Red Planet's ancient environment.
